title: Social Media Privacy Security Checklist
metaDescription: Complete checklist to protect your privacy on Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, X and other social platforms. Secure your personal data today.
intro: Social media platforms collect vast amounts of personal data for advertising and profit. This checklist helps you reclaim control over your privacy across Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, X, and other platforms with practical, step-by-step actions.

items.task: Enable two-factor authentication on all social media accounts
items.why: Prevents unauthorized access even if your password is compromised. 2FA blocks 99.9% of automated attacks.
items.howTo: Go to Security Settings in each platform. Choose SMS, authenticator app, or hardware key. Save backup codes in a secure location.

items.task: Update passwords to unique, strong combinations
items.why: Weak or reused passwords are the #1 cause of account breaches. Each platform needs a unique password.
items.howTo: Use a password manager to generate 12+ character passwords with mixed case, numbers, and symbols. Never reuse passwords across platforms.

items.task: Check recent login activity and active sessions
items.why: Identifies unauthorized access attempts and suspicious locations accessing your account.
items.howTo: Find 'Active Sessions' or 'Login Activity' in security settings. Log out suspicious sessions and change password if needed.

items.task: Set profile and posts to private/friends-only visibility
items.why: Prevents strangers, employers, and data scrapers from accessing your personal information and posts.
items.howTo: Go to Privacy Settings. Set profile info, posts, and photos to 'Friends Only' or 'Private'. Review each visibility option individually.

items.task: Turn off facial recognition and photo tagging features
items.why: Facial recognition creates biometric profiles used for tracking and can be accessed by third parties or law enforcement.
items.howTo: Find 'Face Recognition' in privacy settings and disable. Turn off auto-tagging suggestions and require approval for tags.

items.why: Location data reveals your daily patterns, home/work addresses, and can be used for stalking or burglary.
items.howTo: Turn off location services for social apps in phone settings. Disable geotagging in each app's privacy settings. Remove location from past posts.

items.task: Prevent profile discovery via email/phone lookup
items.why: Stops people from finding your profile using your contact information, reducing unwanted contact attempts.
items.howTo: In privacy settings, find 'Who can find me' options. Disable lookup by email address and phone number. Set to 'Friends' or 'No one'.

items.task: Review and limit advertising data collection
items.why: Reduces targeted advertising based on your behavior and limits data sharing with advertising partners.
items.howTo: Go to Ad Preferences/Settings. Turn off personalized ads. Clear interests and advertisers. Opt out of ads based on partner data.

items.task: Remove connected third-party apps and games
items.why: Third-party apps often access your profile data, friend lists, and posts, then share this information with other companies.
items.howTo: Find 'Connected Apps' or 'Applications' in settings. Remove apps you don't use. Review permissions for remaining apps and limit access.

items.task: Download your data to see what platforms know about you
items.why: Reveals the full scope of data collection including deleted posts, messages, and tracking data you didn't know existed.
items.howTo: Look for 'Download Your Data' option in settings. Request full archive. Review what's collected and adjust privacy settings accordingly.

items.task: Disable contact syncing and friend suggestions
items.why: Stops platforms from accessing your contacts and suggesting friends based on phone numbers, creating shadow profiles.
items.howTo: Turn off contact syncing in app settings. Revoke contact access in phone permissions. Disable friend suggestions based on contacts.

items.task: Use Incognito Browser for social media access
items.why: Prevents tracking cookies and browsing history from being stored, reducing cross-site tracking and data collection.
items.howTo: Download Incognito Browser for private social media browsing. Blocks trackers automatically and doesn't store browsing history or cookies.

items.why: Platforms frequently change privacy policies and reset settings during updates, requiring ongoing monitoring.
items.howTo: Set monthly calendar reminder to check privacy settings. Review new features and their privacy implications. Update settings after major platform updates.
